title: FormRuleDescriptor
description: Describes a conditional form rule with one or more actions that execute when the condition is met.
markdownDescription: AI guidance: use rules for simple client-side behavior such as hiding a group when a checkbox is false, disabling a field after a status is selected, or setting a default value. `condition.fieldId` and every action `targetId` must reference existing field/group ids. Rules are not security boundaries; enforce sensitive behavior with backend validation/interceptors too.

id.description: Unique identifier for this rule. Prefer kebab-case or camelCase such as 'show-archive-reason'.

name.description: Human-readable name for this rule, used by designers/documentation.

condition.description: The condition that triggers this rule. For isEmpty/isNotEmpty, omit value.

fieldId.description: The field whose value is evaluated. Must match a field id in the same form.

operator.description: Comparison operator. Use equals/notEquals with value; use isEmpty/isNotEmpty without value.

value.description: The value to compare against (not used for isEmpty/isNotEmpty)

actions.description: Actions to perform when the condition is met. Actions are executed in order.

type.description: The action type. hide/show/disable/enable target fields or groups; setValue targets fields.

targetType.description: Whether the target is a field or a group.

targetId.description: The id of the target field or group. Must exist in this form's fields or layout groups.

value.description: The value to set. Used only for setValue actions.
